english: The air itself grows freezing cold as you head deeper into the tunnel, until you find the passage blocked by a spiral shell.
It is a massive unit of a Hail Snail. It fills the entire eastern passage.
Imagine if you could lift a thing like this...
You'd be regarded as a mythological mega-man.
The Hail Snail moves its thick head, the blue eye stalks focusing on... you?
The snail is just sitting here? Blocking the tunnel?
Any creature of sufficient size can go where they please.
Size makes right, as they say.
The goblin waltzes up to it and looks it up and down.
This big guy's been here for months.
Last time I was here he was facing... slightly to the left.
Moving closer, you do see that the snail is moving.
Maybe ten degrees. Or five. Not very fast.
The frozen mucus slowly melting around it indicates a pattern.
It is attempting to rotate. By Hail Snail standards, very, very slowly.
It is rotating. Or in layman's terminology: the snail is turning around.
It'll be done by next year probably. Then it'll head straight out of the tunnel in another one or two.
The Hail Snail is potentially rotating slightly more towards you as you approach it in the blocked Eastern Tunnel.
Or at least you think it is rotating. Hard to tell if you don't stand here for an hour or two.
You have a feeling you could.
In either case, you must try.
You focus on the esoteric energies.
The Strings connecting the snail to the pocket.
But they slip through your mental grasp.
Apply heat directly to the shell.
You press your entire body against the frozen shell.
But your body heat. It's working.
Cracks forming in the magical ice.
At first, yeah. Sageleaf had plans of cleaning up the Roots, and establishing a mushroom farm across the South and East Tunnels.

But the prospect of dealing with that kind of cleanup duty wasn't exactly something people were excited by. So when this big boy fell out of a crack last year, the whole thing got postponed, and... lots of Halfway people were very, very fine with it.
He points back through the tunnel.
And ever since, we've only had to deal with invasions from the South Tunnels.
Oh. So this leads to the East Tunnels?
Hm. I wanted to go to the East Tunnels.
Good. I have no business there. Right?
Are you saying that only because you can't go there?
...Trust me, everything east of here is shit.

The East Tunnels just lead to a bunch of dangerous trap-filled spiral halls leading to the Shifting Falls- and then the Water Temple. Technically there's some routes that lead to the Lower Palace as well, but if you wanna go there you'd be better off taking the upper paths.
I'm already excited for it, you don't have to try to sell it, Snell.
You're right. Adventure and spelunking-excitement sounds terrible and bad.
I actually have no opinion on this awesome dungeon experience you're speaking of - I am a person who does not enjoy dungeons.
The goblin just looks at you, his gaze giving a type of neutral, dissociated look.
-basically, this snail halved our work down here is what I'm saying.
He turns to the creature and yells, "So take your time, will ya! All the time in the world!"
A lovely sentiment, but it could hurt you quite a lot.
You could probably make a joke about frostbite. If you tried hard enough.
People have lost limbs to it. Fingers, noses, even toes!
What do you call the guy who lost his toes to frostbite?
Fine. You'll never hear the punchline then.
Good. One less mean joke in the world.
Okay, maybe I don't want to pet the giant frozen snail.
The esoteric frost will... damage you.
You reach forth and place a gloved hand upon the teal mucus-covered shell.
It is hard, and the air is freezing cold.
I figured it was clear by the bone-frigid temperature that it'd be really stupid to pet a magical Ice-Snail. But that's just me!
A deep clicking emanates through the eastern tunnel.
Oh. Is that what they sound like? (Rub your frozen hand.)
By the gods. Yeah, don't get him angry. We like this guy.
The snail is not angry. Not...
Those clickings... they are a happy noise.
You focus on the esoteric Strings.
The leylines connecting the snail to the pocket dimension.
The instability. The crack in the magic.
The esoteric ice begins to melt.
Yeah, I broke the esoteric effect.
Oh. So that means it'll move away from the passage?
Right. That'll make Lady Sageleaf very happy.
He would have preferred for the snail to remain. But he will not complain about it, beyond these guttural noises.
The snail lets out a blubbering, clicking noise.
Other sounds echo from deeper in the hallway.
His family is awakening, all together now.
You should return later, after a rest.
They will be done by then.
The massive shell still blocks the tunnel.
But you can hear movement within.
E-Good, good. (Leave it to wake up, slowly.)
You stand in the Roots chamber.
Lord Rekm has moved here with his family.
Several smaller Hail Snails cluster around the massive patriarch.
The air is cold. Frigid even.
As you approach, the great snail's eye stalks focus on you.
A clicking sound. Both faint and loud at once.
E-"Have a good one, Lord Rekm."
You step closer to the massive snail.
Yeah. The Roots has good moisture levels. And it's cold enough for them without being too cold for us.
Lady Sageleaf is less than thrilled. But she's allowing it. For now.
Five. No, six smaller Hail Snails.
The clicking transforms into words as your spell takes hold.
Lord Rekm's voice is slow. Deliberate.
Like each word costs him great effort.
That's all for now, Lord Rekm. And again, thanks for that gemstone. (Break the spell.)
That's all I wanted to say.
The smaller snails click in unison.
The giant snail slowly unveils something shiny from its mouth.
You get your hands on a slimy gemstone.
Snell glares at the giant gem.
Then he gives you a thumbs up.
Thank you, Lord Rekm. (Break the spell.)
The words fade back into clicking.
A deep clicking emanates from the Hail Snail as the spell's esoteric tinkle fades.
A clicking that slowly transforms into a sentence.
Yes I am. I am a friend.
I don't think we should put labels on it yet.
I'm pretty much an enemy, I think.
Of course not. That would be way too black and white.
The snail's muttering echoes through the cavern.
LORD REKM-NAMMU. You... stand before... a solemn soul...
How did you end up here?
What are you voting in the election?
Do you know anything that could help me, when it comes to the mystery of the tea shop that blew up?
That's all I wanted to ask. (Break the spell.)
His own esoteric cold has trapped him.
A feedback loop of magic and ice.
All trapped in the same hibernation.
When I woke... I was growing...
The esoteric cold... it feeds on itself...
You might be able to help.
If you understand esoteric pockets well enough.
It's when people choose their leaders.
I vote for... whoever helps snails...
The words of the snail slowly transform back into a solemn clicking noise.
